pages.author: Roses Of Rome Pictures

poetry: for the sake of the larger one,
So does anyone who has truly loved.
perplexing_question: If sacrifice is love doing arithmetic in private,
does it need to be witnessed to count—
pages.quote: Sacrifice is love doing its arithmetic quietly, in private.
pages.author: Roses Of Rome Pictures

poetry: It shows up on the difficult Tuesday
as faithfully as the easy Sunday.
is its own kind of miracle.
perplexing_question: If devotion shows up on the difficult Tuesday as much as the easy Sunday,
is it the spark that matters—
the fire that stayed lit after?
pages.quote: Devotion is attention that outlasted the excitement that started it.
pages.author: Roses Of Rome Pictures

poetry: A flower does not bloom to be seen;
it blooms because it is finally ready,
as if breathing for the first time.
when it is only ever a beginning again—
the same bud, the same branch,
finding a new way to open.
perplexing_question: If the flower blooms without asking who is watching,
what readiness looks like from outside?
pages.quote: To bloom is not to finish becoming. It is to open, again, and call it enough.
pages.author: Roses Of Rome Pictures

poetry: To flourish is not merely to survive
but to become fully what you were shaped to be—
the oak does not simply endure its acorn,
it becomes the thing the acorn was quietly promising.
perplexing_question: If forever cannot be measured in years,
not as a length of time,
but as this moment, fully entered?
pages.quote: Forever is not a length of time. It is a way of being present to all of it.
pages.author: Roses Of Rome Pictures
